title: First observation of the force: laser displacement test with Nathan and Dr. Sid Clemens
summary: Charles Buer tells of First observation of the force: laser displacement test with Nathan and Dr. Sid Clemens, about 2010 at laboratory (Florida), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I would say the first time I witnessed it or a force um based on a theory that I had um was probably 2010.

plain: Charles Buer, introduced on a podcast as a former NASA leader working on new propulsion, says that around 2010, in a lab in Florida, he first saw a force predicted by his own theory. He says it showed up in a laser test that measured tiny movements, done with a colleague named Nathan and a scientist, Dr. Sid Clemens. If true, it would be an early sign of a way to push objects without ordinary engines, something like antigravity.
